articles.title: Asus launches four mini PCs in Japan priced from $1,048 to $1,838
articles.description: Asus has launched four mini PCs in Japan, ranging from a tiny 330-gram office PC to a model packing a 12-core AMD Ryzen AI processor. Prices start at around $1,048 and climb to $1,838, yet all four come with just 16 GB of RAM. A closer look at similarly equipped alternatives reveals just how much of a premium Asus is asking for.

articles.title: ASRock's new AIO cooler lets users open the loop and add a GPU water block
articles.description: ASRock’s new Taichi Aqua 360 LCD is an unusual AIO cooler that lets users expand its cooling loop with additional components, including a GPU water block. It also features two pumps, a detachable 3.4-inch LCD and three LCP-blade fans, but its €329 price puts it firmly in the premium category.
